messages:
Emma Torres: Heads up — planning a micro-release tonight 23:00 PT for the inference kernel quantization fix. Targeting hosted & dedicated placements. Need internal RN + ops standby. Change window 23:00–00:30 PT. @Raj Patel can you draft the short RN blurb? :eyes:

Raj Patel: On it. What's the pin we want for model-serving? Should we pin model to v4.1.2-quant or use runtime fallback?

Emma Torres: Pin to model: redwood-model/bert-large@v4.1.2-quant. Runtime fallback policy: if latency > 250ms for >5m on canary, fallback to v4.1.2-fp16. Also canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Add rollback criteria: >2% error rate or >20% latency regression on P95.

Olivia Chen: Draft RN snippet:
```
Release: inference kernel quantization fix (hotfix)
Scope: hosted API + Dedicated pools
What changed: Fixes tokenization regression causing KV cache misalignment under quantized exec. Improves throughput on T4/RTX families.
Pinning: model pinned to redwood-model/bert-large@v4.1.2-quant for this rollout
Canary plan: 5% -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (monitor 30m)
Rollback triggers: >2% error rate OR P95 latency +20% vs baseline
```
Please shorten for internal announce.

Raj Patel: Shortened copy:
'Deploying hotfix: inference kernel quantization alignment. Pinned model: redwood-model/bert-large@v4.1.2-quant. Canary 5→25→100%. Rollback on >2% errors or P95 latency +20%. Change window 23:00–00:30 PT.'
Works?

Emma Torres: Perfect. Add note for support: 'If customers report tokenization artifacts, escalate to eng-ml and attach request ids.'

DeployBot: /deploy start release=hotfix-quant-20260321 canary=5% targets=hosted,dedicated
DeployBot: Started canary for hotfix-quant-20260321. Step: canary @ 5%.

SRE Oncall: Oncall here, I'll monitor canary region (us-west2) and alerts. Ping me if deploybot marks degraded.

DeployBot: Canary metrics: error_rate=0.12% latency_p95=132ms throughput +8% — monitors green.

Raj Patel: Rolling to 25% now. /deploy set canary=25%

DeployBot: Updated canary to 25%. Metrics collecting...

DeployBot: Canary metrics (25%): error_rate=0.15% latency_p95=145ms — within thresholds. No rollback.

Olivia Chen: Internal announce draft for #internal-announce:
'Heads up: We're rolling a hotfix to address quantization alignment in the inference kernel. Model pinned to v4.1.2-quant. Canary in progress; expected full rollout by 00:00 PT. Oncall: SRE Oncall. Escalations: @eng-ml, @support.'

Emma Torres: Send that as the internal announcement at 23:10 PT. I'll pin RN to release notes doc: linked: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/hotfix-quant-20260321

Maya Singh: Acknowledging. I'll prep a short CS note template for customers if needed.

DeployBot: Canary reached 100% — rollout complete. Final metrics: error_rate=0.16% latency_p95=148ms. No rollbacks. Release tag hotfix-quant-20260321 created.

Emma Torres: Thanks team :tada: Closing thread. If anything pops, reopen. Logged RN to release tracker.
